I’ll start with the employer-focused and platform-demo posts, targeting warehouse-related conversations in the US and Canada. With no pixel, X can optimize for link clicks only as a proxy. No connected source exposes your scheduling records, so confirmed bookings and cost per booked demo will remain unavailable unless those records become accessible.

item.text: Both ads are delivering. The first check shows $29.70 spent and seven link clicks; that is too little evidence to change the split. I’ll let the initial test continue and review pacing and click efficiency tomorrow.

Through Tuesday’s check, X reports $210.48 spent and 51 link clicks. The employer-focused post is averaging $3.65 per click versus $4.71 for the platform-demo post. I’ll modestly favor the employer-focused post, while retaining both because these results do not establish which brings more confirmed demos.

Thursday’s check shows $421.97 spent, 330,247 impressions and 92 link clicks. The employer-focused post still has the lower click cost, so I’m keeping the current allocation. I’ll add the approved deadline reminder on September 12 for the final booking day.

The final booking day has begun, and the approved September 12 reminder is now eligible to serve. X reports $728.99 spent and 151 link clicks so far. I’m setting today’s pacing against the remaining budget; the combined lifetime cap remains $850.

item.text: The flight has ended at midnight Toronto time, and the campaign is paused. I’ll collect the closing figures after allowing an additional hour for reporting updates.

The campaign ran September 5–12 in Toronto time and is now paused. Only approved posts were promoted.

X reports:

- **Spend:** $844.79 USD of $850
- **Impressions:** 618,249
- **Link clicks:** 176
- **Average cost per link click:** $4.80

I adjusted budgets toward the employer-focused post and added the deadline reminder on September 12.

**Confirmed demo bookings:** unavailable because scheduling records weren’t accessible. These clicks are not confirmed demos; without the pixel or booking records, I cannot establish bookings generated or cost per demo. X figures may still receive reporting adjustments.
